For a 2-bedroom serviced rental for 4 adults in Goa, switching providers is mostly a matter of rebooking; the main friction is cancellation/refund timing and losing the same property/dates.

Option	Current price signal	Switching difficulty	Key limitation
Unreal Living – Assagao 2BHK	From ₹5,000/night	Low	Price is “from”; confirm taxes and exact dates. 
Unreal Living

Alaya Stays / ELIVAAS – Veera Marina	₹5,816 + ₹782 taxes/night	Low–medium	Cancellation window varies; verify final refundable amount. 
Goibibo

Airbnb – Vianaar Sol Sienda 2BHK	Live price varies by dates	Medium	Cancellation depends on the specific listing/host; platform fees can change the effective cost. 
Airbnb

Before paying: compare the all-in total, cancellation deadline, refund timing, cleaning/service fees, security deposit, guest-count rules, and whether housekeeping is included. Switching is easiest when you book a free-cancellation rate; direct/off-platform bookings can materially reduce dispute protection.

For an Indian couple, three practical routes are:

Atlys — Digital, end-to-end assistance with document review and appointment handling. Its 2026 Germany example shows ~₹10,638 total before any optional extras. 
Atlys

Thomas Cook Visa Services — More traditional, human-assisted service with visa offices including Bengaluru; useful if you want help with documentation and travel planning together. 
Thomas Cook
+1

VFS Global (direct) — Official application-centre route rather than an agent. Typically cheapest for assistance, but you handle preparation yourself. For Italy Bengaluru, the adult visa fee is ₹9,630 plus VFS charges. 
VFS Global

Key difference: Atlys = convenience; Thomas Cook = personalised assistance; VFS = direct/DIY. Visa fees are generally non-refundable, including after refusal.
